description: Start a section on page_id or change the one starting there: page_number_start (sets continue_numbering false), continue_numbering, page_number_style (arabic, upper_roman, lower_roman, upper_letters, lower_letters), section_prefix (up to 8 characters), include_section_prefix, marker (text for the section marker), name. remove true deletes the section starting on page_id (never the first). Returns created, section (read back), previous, sections[] and pages[] {page_id, name} – page names change with the numbering, so re-read them before using page names in export_pdf ranges. Use it for an issue that starts at page 3, roman front matter, or a supplement with its own numbering.

continue_numbering.description: true: continue from the previous section.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_section_prefix.description: Show the prefix in page numbers.

page_id.description: Document page on which the section starts (from list_pages).

page_number_start.description: Page number of the first page of the section; implies continue_numbering false.

remove.description: Remove the section starting on page_id. Not combinable with other settings.

section_prefix.description: Prefix before the page number, up to 8 characters.

name: set_section
title: Start or change a section
